thread:
anika_shah: Heads up: CI flagged package google-kms-plugin v1.2.0 as 'potentially vulnerable' due to a symbol mismatch in the SBOM. It's used in private-deploy agent for KMS keywrap. Requesting a short-lived exception while we investigate. Ticket INFSEC-4923.

vuln-scanner-bot: Snyk: CVE-2025-XXXX - reported in 1 dependency of google-kms-plugin; score 6.1, but feed marks as 'unverified'. Link: https://snyk.io/vuln/CVE-2025-XXXX

kevin_cho: Is this a true vuln or FP? The plugin is built from our fork; we ship pinned binaries.

maria_gonzalez: I looked quickly — the vulnerable symbol is in a non-shared label that our build strips. On-host runtime path doesn't expose the symbol. Needs confirmation from build infra.

jordan_lee: Compensating controls: images are scanned at build time, only internal repos can access, KMS keys are in HSM with restricted IAM. We can enable extra audit logging on calls and rotate keys as precaution.

anika_shah: Proposal: short-lived exception for demo/private-deploy only (non-prod) for 72h while infra verifies build artifact and backports patch. Add mandatory audit log and restrict service account.

kevin_cho: @jordan_lee can you add the audit logging flag and grant temporary SA restrictions? Also need approval from security lead.

jordan_lee: Will add audit webhook and a CloudTrail filter. ETA ~6h. I'll push policy to prod-canary first. snippet:

``
# add logging sink for kms calls
gcloud logging sinks create kms-audit \\
  --log-filter="resource.type=\"k8s_container\" AND protoPayload.methodName:\"Decrypt\"" \\
  --destination=projects/redwood-logs\/sinks\/kms-audit
``

maria_gonzalez: I can verify build artifacts: comparing checksums of our fork vs upstream. If checksums match patched upstream, it's FP. Also can run `strings` on binary to confirm symbol absence.

vuln-scanner-bot: Temporary exception added: INFSEC-4923-exception created by @anika_shah, expires in 72h. Reason: triage in progress. (automated)

devsec-bot: Reminder: exceptions require compensating controls in ticket: audit, SA restriction, artifact verification. Template: https://redwood.internal/docs/sec-exception-template

kevin_cho: :thumbsup: sounds good. Assigning @maria_gonzalez as risk owner. Please update ticket with artifacts and timeline.

anika_shah: I'll request sign-off from @lina_security (security lead). If we confirm FP, we'll close. If not, patch PR to backport to v1.2.x and schedule hotfix in 48h.

lina_security: I've given provisional sign-off contingent on logs + confirmation. Add me to ticket. Keep me updated.

maria_gonzalez: Initial artifact diff: checksums differ — our build differs due to static linking flags. Running `strings` now, will paste result if symbol present.

jordan_lee: Can we also add an allowlist in SBOM scanner for this specific fork SHA while we confirm? Need to avoid noisy alerts across org.

anika_shah: We'll avoid a global allowlist. Use temporary org-scoped exception only for private-deploy-demo env. Tokenized expiry enforced.

maria_gonzalez: No symbol found in strings output. Likely FP. I'll attach binary dump and checksum diffs to the ticket (INFSEC-4923).

lina_security: :white_check_mark: Based on artifact verification and controls, exception approved. Close by 72h or sooner. Good job.

anika_shah: Thanks team. I'll document steps, update INFSEC-4923 with all artifacts and controls, and close the thread when resolved.
